title: CellFate-Rx Gen-1: frozen model and reproducibility artifacts, version 1.0.0
description:
Archived reproducibility bundle for CellFate-Rx Generation 1: a preregistered reanalysis of the six-condition clonal-tracing dataset GEO GSE279162 (generated and deposited by Schaff et al., doi:10.1016/j.xgen.2026.101191). No new data were generated.

Tests whether pretreatment transcriptional state carries condition-specific information about future clonal detection, beyond condition identity and captured pretreatment clone abundance, under clone-held-out evaluation frozen before any result existed.

The archive contains the frozen model artifact, the derived clone pseudobulk cache needed to re-run the permutation null, all out-of-fold predictions, the 1,000 per-draw permutation values and 2,000 bootstrap replicates, every stage protocol and record including failed and negative results, the environment lock, and three verification tools that refuse on any modified artifact. A SHA256SUMS manifest accompanies the bundle.

notes: Verify the archive after unpacking: python experiments/run_gen1_evidence_lock.py --verify ; python experiments/run_gen1_claim_lock.py --verify ; python experiments/run_gen1_manuscript.py --verify . Each re-hashes its layer and refuses on a single changed byte. Bit-identical REFITTING across environments is not claimed; environment_lock.txt records the interpreter that produced the results.
